title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.12180v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. translated_title: TS-GEAR：淘宝闪购生成式广告检索
translated_abstract: 诸如DoorDash和Uber Eats这类即时配送平台存在一个传统电商所没有的约束：超出用户配送范围的商家是无效候选，而不仅仅是排序较低。生成式检索近期在大规模检索系统中展现出强大潜力，然而将其适配到这一场景面临三大挑战。第一，现有语义ID仅将地理位置作为软信号编码，因此可达性只能依赖生成之后的不可微硬截断来保证。第二，用户偏好在不同区域和不同查询之间差异显著，若在不结合地理位置与当前查询的情况下聚合历史行为，会产生有偏的兴趣估计。第三，检索到的候选集合以其整体价值来评估，然而自回归训练对每个序列独立打分，缺乏集合级信号来抑制冗余的近似重复候选。为解决……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TS-GEAR，面向即时配送场景的生成式广告检索，通过显式建模配送范围可达性、基于地理位置与当前查询条件化的用户兴趣表示以及集合级训练信号，解决了语义ID地理信号软化、兴趣估计偏差与候选冗余三大挑战。
en_tdlr: TS-GEAR proposes a generative ad retrieval framework for on-demand delivery platforms that explicitly encodes delivery-range reachability, conditions user interest modeling on geography and the current query, and introduces set-level training signals to eliminate redundant candidates.
